title: Publish an original piece on a site AI engines cite
topic: A practical audit for checking startup-offer benefits, eligibility, exclusions, and application routes before applying
summary: On October 6, 2026, the existing public DEV article was rewritten in place as a 727-word original guide. It now applies a five-field audit to three concrete offers, distinguishes Sourcey evidence dates from the date the vendor pages were rechecked, and links three Sourcey records plus the current vendor pages.

quality_review.citation_review: All three cited Sourcey facts match their dated offer records. The linked current vendor pages were rechecked on 2026-10-06; the article explicitly distinguishes those checks from the older Sourcey evidence dates.

observations.fact: The Kiro record lists up to one year of Kiro Pro+ credits, with packages for up to 2, 10, or 30 users depending on tier; it also records startup-stage, funding, AWS account/email, AWS Activate, age, location, and promotion-window conditions.
The AWS Activate Portfolio record lists up to $200,000 for pre-Series B startups with an AWS Activate Provider Org ID.

The ActiveCampaign Incubator record lists 90% off an annual plan for the first year for a new customer under two years old who is currently an incubator partner or recent alum and has raised no more than $1,000,000.
